_comment: Real 'Strategic Portfolio Expansion' deal (synthetic, Jaskirat Rangi's largest open opportunity) shaped to the opportunityCard attribute contract. This is the payload a Custom Lightning Type renderer.json (Agentforce, flat $attrs.<field>) or MCP wrapper/payload CLT (nested outputValues.opportunity.<field>) maps into the widget. STANDARD objects only: Opportunity, OpportunityFieldHistory, Case, Task, Event, plus an Opportunity.StageName describe for stage position. Every value below is DERIVED in Apex (OpportunityAction.cls), it is not a stored field: healthHeadline/healthReasons/healthVariant come from the Deal Readiness score, recommendedStepList is the ranked firing signals, daysInStageLabel is stage age from field history, casesLabel counts material cases. A reference snapshot, not a live capture; values may drift from the org.

attributes.healthReasons: Driven by an overdue follow-up and a high-priority service case. Leading risk: the decision timeline remains unconfirmed.
attributes._health_note: healthVariant is one of success (≥80) / warning (≥60) / error (<60), keyed to the Deal Readiness band. This deal sits at 70 -> Attention needed -> warning.

recommendedStepList.text: Complete the overdue "Follow-up: Decision Timeline Confirmation" task.
Resolve the high-priority case "Mortgage Refinance - Rate Lock Extension" before it stalls the deal.

attributes._steps_note: recommendedStepList is the top-ranked firing risk signals (highest-urgency first); the single top signal is also the Leading Risk quoted in healthReasons, so score, leading risk and actions never disagree.
attributes.objective: Client seeking diversified investment strategy across multiple asset classes including equities, fixed income, and alternative investments.
attributes.nextStep: Schedule investment risk assessment meeting and prepare comprehensive portfolio analysis proposal.
attributes._cases_note: casesLabel counts ALL related cases (6 cases · 2 open); the cases array carries the material ones surfaced in the Activity & Risks drill-down. Only Priority='High' OR Type='Problem' cases deduct Deal Readiness, routine asks still list but never over-flag the deal.
attributes._url_note: Every url is built at runtime from URL.getOrgDomainUrl() + /lightning/r/<Object>/<id>/view; ids are org-specific and omitted here.
